title: How Elemental Combos Work in Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD
subtitle: Every pair, triple and four element combo, what it does and how to trigger it on purpose.
description: How do elemental tower combos work? A full guide to steam, lava, plasma and every other combo in Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD, with damage, effects and mastery.
card: All 11 elemental combos in Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD, what triggers them, what they do, and how combo mastery makes them stronger over time.

faq.q: How do combos trigger in Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD?
faq.a: When towers of different elements hit the same enemy within 1.5 seconds of each other, the game checks the elements involved and fires the matching combo, adding bonus damage and a status effect to that enemy.
There are 11: six pair combos, four triple combos and one four element combo called Cataclysm. The more different elements land on an enemy inside the window, the stronger the combo.

Every time you trigger a combo it counts towards a lifetime total. At 25, 100, 300, 800 and 2000 triggers the combo levels up, adding 5 percent damage per level and extra effect duration at levels 3 and 5.
